cases.title: Workspace terminal cut from the picked base
steps: Start graph-manager as TESTING.md describes
Use a workspace whose checkout is on development and whose origin default is main
Open the New Terminal dialog on it, keep Base = main, click Create
Run git rev-parse HEAD in the terminal and git rev-parse origin/main in the checkout
cases.expected: Both hashes match; the pane header shows gm-term/<id> ← main; the checkout's git status is unchanged

cases.title: Base list loads instantly and refreshes after fetch; offline still works
steps: Start graph-manager as TESTING.md describes
Open the New Terminal dialog on a workspace
Observe the Base dropdown and spinner
Repeat with the origin remote unreachable
cases.expected: Branches are listed with the default preselected before the fetch ends, a spinner shows during it; offline shows 'Offline: local branches' and Create still opens a terminal (with a warning)

cases.title: Project terminal is isolated
steps: Start graph-manager as TESTING.md describes
Open a terminal on a project with two committed repos
In it, run realpath repos/<name> and create a file under repos/<name>/

Check git status in each repo checkout and in the shared .projects/

folder
cases.expected:
cwd is .projects/

/.gm-worktrees/; repos/ resolve to /.gm-worktrees/; the checkouts and the shared project folder show no changes

cases.title: Closing an untouched project terminal cleans up
steps: Start graph-manager as TESTING.md describes
Open a project terminal and close it without changes
cases.expected: DELETE answers 204; no gm-term/<id> branch or .gm-worktrees/<id> folder remains in any repo or the project folder

cases.title: Close with work, keep, reopen
steps: Start graph-manager as TESTING.md describes
Open a project terminal, change a file in repos/<a>/, close it
Choose Keep all
Click Open terminal on the kept entry under the project
cases.expected: The close dialog lists per-repo counts with Delete all / Keep all / Create PR / Cancel; the kept entry is listed under the project; reopening uses the same folder without the New Terminal dialog

cases.title: No-commit repo and rollback
steps: Start graph-manager as TESTING.md describes
Open a project terminal on a project containing a repo with no commits
Then try opening one with a base branch that does not exist in one repo
cases.expected: The no-commit repo row says 'No commits yet: not isolated' and links to the checkout; the bad base answers an error naming the repo and leaves no worktrees or gm-term branches behind

cases.title: Merge project files
steps: Start graph-manager as TESTING.md describes
In a project terminal, create CLAUDE.md in the terminal's folder
Click Merge project files in the close dialog
Repeat with a conflicting change committed in the shared project folder
cases.expected: The first merge lands commit 'gm: project files from ' in .projects/<p>; the conflict answers 409 listing the file, the project folder is clean with no merge in progress, and the worktree is kept

cases.title: Create PR from a project terminal
steps: Start graph-manager as TESTING.md describes
Connect a forge as TESTING.md describes
In a project terminal change files in two of three repos, close it and choose Create PR
cases.expected: Two PRs open, each into its repo's chosen base and linking the other; the third repo shows skipped

cases.title: Single-repo run from a project terminal
steps: Start graph-manager as TESTING.md describes
In a project terminal, call open_start_run with tasksDir and spec inside repos/<a>/
Then call open_start_run with project: true
cases.expected: The first opens repo <a>'s workspace Start run form with paths relative to the repo and Start from gm-term/<id>; the second opens the project suite form
